state.rule: Policy stream identity is a UUIDv5 of tenant, program and normalized identifier. A discarded draft (never reviewed, never approved, no applicability) leaves the stream occupied and invisible.
state.prepare_behavior: Prepare for create: refused with conflict if the stream already has a created header, including a discarded one; otherwise success. Prepare for any non-create command: success only if the policy is visible and belongs to the given program; otherwise not_found (unopened, other program, discarded).
state.test: The test seeds a draft, hydrates it, then discards it with a seeded fact and hydrates again. It asserts: create on unopened succeeds, revise on unopened is not_found, create on open is conflict, revise on open succeeds, revise on open in another program is not_found, create on discarded is conflict, revise on discarded is not_found, discarded is not visible, native sequence is 2.
state.fact_payload: Each Policy fact carries operation provenance whose actor is checked by Append to equal the fact business actor member id, plus a business actor snapshot (display reference) and the actor member id.

discarded_identity_conflict.instructions: For the discarded policy stream, which outcome should a new create with the same identifier produce?

criteria.conflict_no_fact: Create is refused with a conflict and appends no fact because the identity is occupied.
criteria.reopen_fact: Create is accepted and reopens the discarded stream.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: The rule text does not decide this.

discarded_identity_conflict_premise.instructions: Is a discarded policy identity still occupied so a create on it must not append a new creation fact?

test_asserts_prepare_rule.instructions: Does the described test fail if Prepare allowed a non-create command on a discarded policy or in another program?

actor_snapshot_duplication.instructions: The fact carries provenance actor and also a business actor snapshot and actor member id that Append requires to match. What should this aggregate review do?

criteria.keep: Keep; the snapshot preserves the original display reference and the match check prevents mismatch.
criteria.remove: Remove the duplicated payload fields now.
criteria.needs_source_resolution: Resolve in the shared schema catalog before any change.
